title: Switch JmapUri object references from jmap: to urn:jmap:
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[chat-core] Switch JmapUri object references from jmap: to urn:jmap:
Spec (80ae683, 57243ea): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L1845-1866: "jmap-urn = \"urn:jmap:\" segment *( \":\" segment ) / segment = 1*( ALPHA / DIGIT / \"-\" / \"_\" )" ... "2. An object URN type: a type name registered in the \"JMAP Object URN Types\" registry ({{JMAP-CHAT-CALENDARS}}). The rest of the name is `<accountId>:<objectId>`" ... "the NSS is compared case-sensitively". Commit 80ae683: "jmap: links replaced by ... object URNs with a new IANA registry"; spec HEAD example `urn:jmap:calendarevent:A13824:E6B2`.
Code: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:1-19 (module doc: private-use `jmap:` scheme); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:155-160 FromStr (requires first segment "jmap"); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:176 Display (writes "jmap:{type}:{acct}"); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:29,33,63-67 (doc example and error strings); crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/jmap_uri.rs, tests/chat_calendars.rs, tests/chat_tasks.rs ("jmap:" fixtures)
Now: JmapUri parses and emits `jmap:<type>:<acct>:<obj>`, so a spec URN `urn:jmap:calendarevent:A:E` fails with NotJmapScheme, and our emitted references are not URNs.
Change: Parse a `urn:jmap:` prefix (NID compare case-insensitive per RFC 8141; NSS case-sensitive) and emit `urn:jmap:<type>:...`. Update the docs and the error strings. The chat-calendars and chat-tasks drafts are the primary source; chat-00 defines the namespace.

[chat-ext] Replace jmap: URI with urn:jmap: object URN in JmapUri
Spec (80ae683, 57243ea): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-calendars-00.md:96-104 "jmap-object-urn = \"urn:jmap:\" type-name \":\" account-id \":\" object-id; type-name = 1*( %x61-7A / DIGIT ) ; registered in \"JMAP Object URN Types\"; account-id = 1*255id-char; object-id = 1*255id-char"; :108 "A type name never equals the first segment after `urn:jmap:` of any other URN assigned under `urn:jmap:`: the capability URNs (such as `chat` ...) and the `urn:jmap:chat:cap:*` MessageAction and Endpoint types"; :181 "`urn:jmap:calendarevent:<accountId>:<eventId>`"; :271 "`urn:jmap:principal:<accountId>:<principalId>`"; draft-atwood-jmap-chat-tasks-00.md:191 "A JMAP object URN ... of type `task`, in the form `urn:jmap:task:<accountId>:<taskId>`"
Code: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:1-13 (module docs: private-use jmap: scheme, tasks extra segment); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:36-40 (object_ids: Vec<Id>); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:93-113 (new accepts 1..n object ids); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:155-171 (FromStr requires scheme "jmap", accepts trailing segments); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:174-178 (Display writes "jmap:..."); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:46-47,61-67 (NotJmapScheme / error text); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/tasks.rs:16-17,34-36,74-89 (JmapUri::task_ids returns (taskListId, taskId) from 2-segment form); crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/jmap_uri.rs:12-98; crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/chat_tasks.rs:228-250; crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/chat_calendars.rs:139,197,202
Now: Parses and renders "jmap:<type>:<acct>:<id>[:<id>...]"; a spec-conformant "urn:jmap:calendarevent:A1:E1" fails with NotJmapScheme, and the code emits "jmap:..." strings peers no longer recognise. The task form is jmap:task:<acct>:<taskListId>:<taskId>, but the new form has no taskListId. Because the type is only checked as lowercase alnum, "urn:jmap:chat:cap:task" would parse once the prefix is changed (type "chat"), which the collision rule is meant to rule out.
Change: Parse and render "urn:jmap:<type>:<accountId>:<objectId>" with exactly one object-id ("urn" and NID "jmap" matched case-insensitively per RFC 8141). Reject a type that collides with assigned urn:jmap: first segments (at least "chat", "did", "cid", "vtc", "scene"), or accept only registered types (calendarevent, principal, task). Collapse object_ids to a single object_id. Replace task_ids() with a single-id accessor (or drop it in favour of data_type() == "task" plus object_id()), and update JMAP_URI_TASK_TYPE docs. Update the three test files to the new draft text as oracle.
Verifier correction: As proposed: parse and render urn:jmap:<type>:<accountId>:<objectId> with exactly one object-id, and drop the task taskListId segment and task_ids(). Treat collision or registered-type filtering as recommended hardening, since the spec states the collision rule as a registry policy and not as a parser requirement.
